replies.Do you ever get anxious when thinking ab: Not typically anxious about math itself, but I do get stressed when time is tight or I’m stuck on complex problems. My low neuroticism score helps me stay calm, though I sometimes feel frustrated when concepts don’t click quickly.
replies.Did you ever use AI to support your math: I used a math app last year for quick problem-solving, but it wasn’t helpful for deeper understanding. It’s good for basic drills but doesn’t explain steps well, which is why I prefer hands-on practice over AI tools.
